newsitem.title: USA: Imperial Credit sets special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Credit sets special dividend.

text.p: Imperial Credit Mortgage Holdings Inc said it has approved a special cash dividend of $0.42 a share, payable on December 16, to stockholders of record on November 15.
The special cash dividend will be used to distribute excess taxable income not previously distributed by the company as dividends, in order to comply with real estate investment trust guidelines.
Imperial Credit is a specialty financing company which operates as a real estate investment trust.
